summary.text: Beth Liston is a member of the Ohio Senate, representing District 16 in northern Franklin County. The Senate's biography says she is serving her first term in the Senate after three terms in the Ohio House and is the ranking member on the Health and Medicaid committees.

paragraphs.text: The Senate's biography says Liston began her career in medicine, earning an MD and PhD at The Ohio State University and training in internal medicine and pediatrics at Yale New Haven Hospital.
It says she joined the Ohio State faculty in 2006, has worked as a hospitalist caring for adults and children, and is a professor of clinical internal medicine and pediatrics.
The biography says Liston first ran for office in 2018 to bring a better understanding of the impact of policy on health and wellness to the General Assembly.

It says she also serves on the Agriculture and Natural Resources, Financial Institutions and Insurance, Rules and Reference, Small Business and Economic Opportunity, and Ways and Means committees and the Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee.
It says she is a past president of the Columbus Medical Association and lives in the Dublin area with her husband and their two children.
